sections: Aniimo is a free-to-play, open-world creature-catching RPG from Pawprint Studio. Players explore the continent of Idyll, catch creatures with Aniipods, and use Twine to become collected Aniimo for combat, puzzles and traversal. Official store information confirms single-player, online co-op, online PvP and cross-platform multiplayer, while detailed launch-version systems will be verified before they are treated as settled facts.

Aniimo launches globally on PC and consoles on September 16, 2026, followed by iOS and Android on September 23. PlayStation lists 10:00 UTC+8 for PS5, but exact Steam, Epic Games, Xbox and mobile unlock hours have not been separately confirmed. Our release and server-time guides distinguish official dates from estimates and local store displays.

Yes. Steam officially lists Cross-Platform Multiplayer alongside online co-op and online PvP. Pawprint Studio has not yet published the exact platform pairings or confirmed cross-save, cross-progression and shared-purchase rules. The crossplay guide keeps confirmed multiplayer support separate from account and progress features that still require an official launch FAQ.
What is included in this Aniimo Wiki?

This independent Aniimo Wiki and guide database currently includes a searchable snapshot of 94 official Wiki entries, plus guides to elements, roles, forms, catching, multiplayer, regions and launch preparation. Creature confirmation is not a tier ranking: Aniimo builds, locations, matchup values and tier lists will only be marked release-tested after repeatable checks in the public game version.
faq: Is Aniimo free to play?
Yes. Pawprint Studio and the official platform listings describe the base game as free to play, with optional in-game purchases.
What platforms is Aniimo on?
The announced platforms are PlayStation 5, Xbox, Steam, Epic Games Store, iOS and Android.
How many Aniimo are confirmed?
The public official Wiki listed 94 visible index entries when checked on August 30, 2026.
Is this the official Aniimo website?
No. Aniimo Guide is an independent fan-made guide and is not affiliated with Pawprint Studio, FunPlus or the official Aniimo team.

getting-started.title: Aniimo Beginner Guide: Launch Preparation
getting-started.description: Aniimo release dates, platforms, account preparation and a sourced beginner launch checklist.
body: What is Aniimo?

Aniimo is a free-to-play creature-catching open-world RPG set on Idyll. Players catch creatures with Aniipods, Twine with collected Aniimo, and use their abilities for combat, puzzles and traversal such as gliding, diving and burrowing.
Launch dates and platform choice

PC and consoles launch September 16, 2026, followed by iOS and Android on September 23. Choose a primary platform before creating a character because cross-save, shared purchases and platform-account linking are not yet confirmed.
Account and event preparation

Use a recoverable email. The Time to Aniimo event requires its email to match the email used for the first launch character. Store wishlists, website registration and paid PlayStation pre-order packs are separate actions; the base game is free.
Storage and accessibility

Steam lists 12 GB RAM and 45 GB available storage as minimums. PS5 lists subtitles, basic remapping, sensitivity options, no-hold controls, manual saving, practice support and voice-chat transcription, but other platforms may differ.
What to verify after launch

Treat beta routes, values and reward tables as provisional. At launch, verify server selection, account linking, download size, controller settings and the current version before following detailed builds or tier lists.

core-gameplay.title: Aniimo Gameplay: Catching, Twine & Exploration
core-gameplay.description: Learn the confirmed core gameplay systems in Aniimo.
body: Catch with timing and tools

Official descriptions say players use Aniipods, set traps and time a catch. Which Aniimo appear can depend on environment, weather, phenomena and time of day; exact release rates and optimal tools still need testing.
Twine for combat, puzzles and movement

Twine lets a Pathfinder become a collected Aniimo and use its perspective and abilities. Official examples include solving puzzles, fighting, gliding, diving and burrowing rather than treating every Aniimo as only a battle unit.
Evolution and forms

Most Aniimo can evolve, and official index entries include different forms. Evolution conditions, form availability and stat changes should be checked against the public release before beta instructions are treated as final.
Solo, multiplayer and real-time challenges

Steam lists single-player, online co-op, online PvP and cross-platform multiplayer. Egg Heist is the clearest confirmed three-player PvEvP example, while general story co-op limits remain unpublished.
RV camps and Homeland

Each Pathfinder has a personal RV at an open-world campsite where players can meet. Homeland is described as supporting crops, decoration and arranging a space with Aniimo, but launch limits and visitor permissions still require verification.

download-preload.title: Aniimo Download & Preload Guide for PC, Console and Mobile
download-preload.description: Where to download Aniimo and what is officially confirmed about preload on Steam, Epic, PS5, Xbox, iOS and Android.
body: Where to download Aniimo
Use the platform links on the official Aniimo website for Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation 5, Xbox, App Store, and Google Play. Avoid unofficial APK, launcher, or key-download sites.
Is release preload available?

As checked on August 29, Pawprint Studio has not published a global-launch preload timetable. The July beta had a separate pre-download guide, but its dates and client do not confirm the release preload schedule.
PlayStation pre-order packs are not preload

PlayStation currently sells optional Advanced and Collector’s pre-order packs. The store states that the base game becomes free at launch; buying a reward pack does not prove that the release client can already be preloaded.
PC preparation
Steam lists 45 GB of available storage. Keep extra space for unpacking and patches, update GPU drivers, and sign in to the store account you plan to use before launch.
Console and mobile preparation
Enable automatic updates and verify free space on your device. Store pages can roll out at different times by region, so use the official listing rather than a search advertisement.
What we will update
This page will be updated when official preload times, launcher instructions, download sizes, and launch-day patch details are announced.

server-launch-times.title: Aniimo Server Launch Time by Region
server-launch-times.description: Aniimo global launch dates and the currently confirmed server-opening time converted for major regions.
server-launch-times.h1: Aniimo Server Launch Time by Region
body: Confirmed launch time

The official PlayStation listing states that the PS5 free-to-play launch begins September 16, 2026 at 10:00 UTC+8. Pawprint Studio separately confirms September 16 for PC and consoles and September 23 for mobile, but has not separately published an exact Steam or Xbox server-opening hour.
Regional conversion
10:00 UTC+8 equals 02:00 UTC, 03:00 BST, 04:00 CEST, 22:00 EDT on September 15, and 19:00 PDT on September 15. Daylight-saving rules can change, so confirm your local store countdown.
Mobile launch time
September 23 is confirmed for mobile, but a precise global server-opening hour has not been published. Do not assume it uses the same 10:00 UTC+8 time until Pawprint Studio confirms it.
Steam date difference

Steam currently displays September 15, while Pawprint Studio’s global announcement uses September 16. This is consistent with the PlayStation time falling on September 15 in the Americas, but use the live platform countdown rather than assuming every platform unlocks simultaneously.
Server regions
Beta notices used APAC, Europe, and America schedules, but final launch server names, maintenance windows, and character-transfer rules remain unconfirmed.

crossplay-cross-save.title: Is Aniimo Crossplay? Cross-Platform & Cross-Save Status
crossplay-cross-save.description: Is Aniimo crossplay? See the confirmed cross-platform multiplayer listing and the current cross-save, cross-progression and account-linking status.
crossplay-cross-save.h1: Is Aniimo Crossplay? Cross-Platform and Cross-Save Status
evidence: The official Time to Aniimo web event says its reward reaches the first launch character when the event email matches the email used to create that character. This confirms reward attribution for one event only; it does not confirm cross-save, platform-account merging or progress transfer.
Official launch and Time to Aniimo notice
body: Short answer

Yes, Steam officially lists Aniimo as supporting Cross-Platform Multiplayer, online co-op and online PvP. The exact PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox and mobile combinations have not yet been documented, so only the general crossplay feature is confirmed.
Crossplay, cross-save and cross-progression are different

Crossplay lets people on different platforms play together. Cross-save or cross-progression carries characters and progress between platforms. Pawprint Studio has not yet confirmed cross-save, shared purchases or character transfer.
Account linking remains unconfirmed

Launch instructions for linking Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation, Xbox, Apple and Google identities have not been published. Pre-registration with an email account does not by itself prove that every platform identity will merge.
Purchases, regions and friend lists

Premium currency, platform-exclusive items, server regions and friend lists may have restrictions. Do not buy currency on one platform expecting it to appear elsewhere until an official launch FAQ confirms the rules.
Safest launch approach
Choose a primary platform, use the same recoverable email where the platform permits it, and avoid creating duplicate characters until official account-linking instructions are available.

faq: Is Aniimo crossplay?
Yes. Steam lists Cross-Platform Multiplayer, but the exact supported platform combinations have not yet been published.
Does Aniimo support cross-platform multiplayer?
Cross-platform multiplayer is officially listed together with online co-op and online PvP. Final pairing and server details remain pending.
Does Aniimo have cross-save?
Cross-save and cross-progression have not been officially confirmed. Do not assume characters, progress or purchases transfer between platforms.
Can I move progress between PC, console and mobile?
Pawprint Studio has not published account-linking or progress-transfer rules for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox, iOS and Android.

steam-deck.title: Does Aniimo Work on Steam Deck? Compatibility Status
steam-deck.description: Aniimo Steam Deck support is not yet verified. Compare the official PC requirements and current compatibility status.
body: No official Steam Deck rating yet
Aniimo has not been marked Steam Deck Verified or Playable on its Steam store page. Pawprint Studio has not announced a dedicated handheld mode.
Why compatibility is uncertain

The minimum specification lists Windows 10, 12 GB RAM, an i7-9700 or Ryzen 5 3600X, and GTX 1060 or RX 6600-class graphics. These desktop requirements cannot be translated directly into guaranteed Deck performance.
Linux and anti-cheat
SteamOS compatibility can depend on Proton, launcher behavior, account services, codecs, and anti-cheat. Those details have not been confirmed for the release build.
Cloud gaming is not confirmed

Pawprint Studio has not announced Aniimo for GeForce NOW or another cloud-gaming catalogue. Its NVIDIA announcement concerns a post-launch NVIDIA ACE interaction feature, not cloud streaming. Do not treat general GeForce NOW support on Steam Deck as confirmation that Aniimo is playable there.
Testing plan
After release we will test installation, login, controls, text size, frame pacing, battery use, suspend/resume, and online modes before assigning a recommendation.
faq: Is Aniimo Steam Deck Verified?
No Steam Deck Verified or Playable rating is currently shown on the Steam store page.
Can Aniimo run on Steam Deck?
It has not been officially verified. Desktop PC requirements do not prove Steam Deck performance or SteamOS compatibility.
Will Aniimo be on GeForce NOW?
GeForce NOW support has not been officially announced. The current NVIDIA ACE announcement is about post-launch Aniimo interaction features, not cloud streaming.

egg-heist.title: Aniimo Egg Heist Guide: PvEvP Mode Explained
egg-heist.description: How Operation: Egg Heist worked in the Aniimo beta, including teams, Lost Isles objectives, combat and launch caveats.
body: What Egg Heist is

Operation: Egg Heist is a three-player PvEvP activity in the Lost Isles. Beta notices describe gathering supplies, entering a forbidden area, fighting Alpha Aniimo or rival Pathfinders and competing for eggs including the Giant Darkler Egg.
Beta access and objectives

One beta preview required Veteran Pathfinder rank. A later update allowed evacuation after either personally submitting one Aniimo Egg or personally collecting a reduced Eggshell Coin target. These are dated beta rules, not guaranteed launch requirements.
Team egg sharing and evacuation risk

In the February 4 beta update, successfully submitted Aniimo Eggs were shared with the team after a safe evacuation. If evacuation failed, a player received only the Eggs they personally submitted. This makes individual submission and team survival distinct decisions.
PvP and Team Mode differences

The February 2 notes disabled carried-item rune effects in Operation: Egg Heist PvP while leaving them active in Egg Heist: Team Mode. The same update added carried items and runes to Alpha chest rewards and adjusted Eggshell Coin exchanges.
Protection and fixes

Beta patches added brief invulnerability when entering the battlefield and barriers near the central river, while also fixing minimap, matchmaking and unexpected untwine issues. These changes show the mode evolved quickly during testing.
Launch verification checklist

The public build must confirm unlock rank, queue types, team size, extraction targets, shared rewards, loss conditions, rune rules, shop limits, map flow and whether Darkler-form rewards remain available before this page is labeled release-tested.

faq: Is Egg Heist a three-player mode?
Official store and beta descriptions identify a three-player team, but the public launch queue must still be checked.
What is the main Egg Heist objective?
Beta versions involved gathering supplies and Eggs, confronting PvE or rival players, meeting a personal evacuation objective and extracting safely.
Are submitted Eggs shared with teammates?
A February 4 beta update shared successfully submitted Eggs after safe evacuation; failed evacuation returned only a player's own submitted Eggs.
Do carried-item runes work in PvP?
A February 2 beta update disabled rune effects in Operation: Egg Heist PvP while retaining them in Team Mode. Launch behavior is unconfirmed.
Are these final launch rules?
No. They are a sourced beta timeline and will be rechecked against the public version.

elements-roles.title: Aniimo Elements & Roles: Element Chart and Counters
elements-roles.description: How do Aniimo elements and roles work? See all nine official elements, five role labels and what is still unknown about counters and damage multipliers.
body: Nine official index elements
The official Wiki currently filters Aniimo by holy, fire, ice, dark, electric, grass, water, rock, and wind. These labels are confirmed; a complete numerical weakness chart is not.
Five listed roles
The same index lists DPS, Heal, Support, BREAK, and REGEN. A creature may contribute through damage, recovery, buffs or control, defense breaking, or energy recovery rather than raw attack alone.
Counters in beta

An official beta handbook mentioned fire, water, grass, and lightning counters and recommended a balanced roster for Alpha battles. The full release matchup chart and damage multipliers have not been published.
Dual-element and form changes
Official entries can show more than one element or different forms. Nimbi, for example, is listed with wind and electric variants, so one name does not always describe a single combat profile.
Building teams responsibly
Do not treat a role filter as a tier ranking. Release testing must account for skills, traits, forms, enemy weaknesses, stamina and team synergy.

faq: How many elements are in Aniimo?
The official Wiki currently lists nine: Holy, Fire, Ice, Dark, Electric, Grass, Water, Rock and Wind.
What roles are in Aniimo?
The official index uses DPS, Heal, Support, Break and Regen role labels.
What are the Aniimo element counters?
Official beta material mentioned counters involving Fire, Water, Grass and Electric, but the complete launch-version matchup chart and numerical multipliers have not been published.
Is an Aniimo role the same as a tier ranking?
No. A role describes a combat function, while a tier ranking requires release-version testing of skills, stats, forms and team synergy.

evolution-forms.title: Aniimo Evolution & Forms Explained
evolution-forms.description: How Aniimo evolution stages, branching evolution and alternate forms are presented in official Wiki and beta information.
body: Official stages

The official Wiki filters entries by Lumin, Gamma and Nova stages. Evolution lines can contain several numbered entries or more than one Nova outcome, so stage and species ID must be tracked separately.
Branching evolution and player choice

Official beta material describes multi-branch evolution. A January 30 beta update said Fenrier unlocked the option to evolve into Glynsera at level 29, showing that a condition may open a choice rather than force an immediate evolution.
Location and bonding conditions

A February 4 update improved evolution-condition wording and added coordinate tracking for objectives at specific locations. It also changed Piopiota's condition to approaching and successfully bonding with Susuta until it turns red and follows the player.
Forms and Morph Orbs

The same update added Basic forms to Morph Orb transformation options. Forms may change appearance, element, skills or movement without necessarily becoming a different species entry; Morph Orb availability and costs still need launch verification.
Special form terms
Beta notices mention Prismana, Darkler, Sparkling, Alpha and weather-related forms. Event preservation and trading rules varied, so none should be generalized to every form at launch.
Release database plan
The release-tested database will separate species ID, stage, form ID, unlock objective, element, skills, location, item cost and game version so beta conditions are not presented as permanent rules.

faq: Does every Aniimo evolve at a fixed level?
No. Official beta examples include levels, branching choices, bonding interactions and location objectives.
How did Fenrier evolve into Glynsera in beta?
A January 30 update said the option unlocked when Fenrier reached level 29. The launch condition is unconfirmed.
What was Piopiota's beta evolution condition?
A February 4 update required approaching and bonding with Susuta until it turned red and followed the player.
Are forms the same as evolution stages?
Not always. Basic, habitat, weather and special forms can be transformations rather than a new evolution-stage species.
Are these final launch conditions?
No. They are versioned beta examples that will be rechecked in the public build.

pre-registration.title: Aniimo Pre-Registration Guide & Rewards
pre-registration.description: How to pre-register for Aniimo on PC, console and mobile, plus confirmed global milestone rewards.
body: Where to pre-register
Start from the official Aniimo website and choose PS5, Xbox, Steam, Epic Games, App Store, or Google Play. Store availability can vary by country, so use the platform button shown for your region.
Official milestone rewards

The official campaign lists Glimmer ×200 at 10 million registrations, Aniipod Ultra ×2 at 15 million, the limited Companion Promise avatar frame at 20 million, and the Sunlit Meadow limited outfit at 30 million.
Time to Aniimo web event

The official Time to Aniimo event runs through September 3, 2026 at 23:59 UTC+8. Log in daily to hatch Aniimo, exchange duplicates with friends, and work toward the limited profile-card background reward.
Match the event email

The official notice says the event email must match the email used to create your first character after launch for the reward to be delivered. Use an address you control and do not create the first character with a different email if you want the event reward.
Event language scope
The web event currently supports English, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese. This four-language event page is separate from the full game's 13-language Steam listing.
Website registration and store wishlists

A website registration, store wishlist, mobile pre-order, and console pre-order are not necessarily the same action. Complete the official account registration and then follow the relevant store page for the platform you intend to use.
Paid PlayStation packs
Aniimo's base game is free. PlayStation sells optional pre-order packs containing cosmetics or a Companion Handbook; buying a pack is not required to play.

system-requirements.title: Aniimo PC System Requirements: Minimum & Recommended
system-requirements.description: Official Aniimo PC requirements covering Windows, CPU, GPU, RAM, DirectX, internet and storage.
body: Minimum PC requirements
64-bit Windows 10; Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600X; 12 GB RAM; NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600; DirectX 11; broadband internet; and 45 GB of available storage.
Recommended PC requirements
64-bit Windows 10 or newer; Intel Core i7-12700F or AMD Ryzen 7 7700X; 16 GB RAM; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 6800; DirectX 11; broadband internet; and 45 GB available storage.
DLSS 4.5 is officially announced

Pawprint Studio announced NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Dynamic Multi Frame Generation and Super Resolution using a second-generation transformer model. The announcement describes dynamic frame multipliers intended to balance frame rate, image quality and responsiveness.
What DLSS support does not yet confirm

The official announcement does not provide a final supported-GPU table, launch preset list, latency measurements or per-resolution performance. AMD FSR, Intel XeSS, ray tracing and a frame-rate cap have not been officially confirmed in the sources checked.
Storage, laptop and handheld planning
Keep additional space beyond the listed 45 GB for unpacking, shader caches and patches. Mobile GPU names do not map directly to desktop cards, and Steam Deck compatibility remains unconfirmed.
Internet requirement
Steam requires broadband internet and lists online interaction. Even for solo play, plan for downloads, account services and online checks.

faq: How much storage does Aniimo need?
Steam currently lists 45 GB of available storage for both the minimum and recommended PC requirements.
Does Aniimo support DLSS 4.5?
Yes. Pawprint Studio officially announced DLSS 4.5 Dynamic Multi Frame Generation and Super Resolution; exact launch settings and supported GPUs still need confirmation.
Does Aniimo support FSR or XeSS?
AMD FSR and Intel XeSS have not been officially confirmed in the sources checked.
Does Aniimo require an SSD?
The Steam requirement table does not specify SSD or HDD. Keep extra room for unpacking and patches.
Can a laptop run Aniimo?
Compare its exact CPU and GPU with the listed desktop requirements. Mobile GPU names are not direct performance equivalents.
Is Aniimo Steam Deck compatible?
Steam Deck compatibility has not been officially confirmed. See the dedicated status guide.

free-to-play.title: Is Aniimo Free to Play? Price & Purchases Explained
free-to-play.description: Aniimo is a free-to-play game with optional in-game purchases. Learn what is confirmed before launch.
body: Yes, the base game is free
Pawprint Studio and the official store listings describe Aniimo as free to play. The base client does not require a standard purchase price.
Optional purchases are confirmed
Steam and PlayStation both disclose optional in-game purchases. PlayStation also lists paid pre-order packs with cosmetics and Companion Handbook items.
What has not been fully detailed
Final prices, regional currencies, battle-pass cadence, premium currency rates, and the complete shop catalogue have not yet been published. Closed-beta values should not be treated as final.
Can you play without buying a pack?
Yes. PlayStation's store notice explicitly says the base game is available at no cost. Pre-order packs are optional extras, not an entry fee.
Our review standard
After launch we will separate cosmetic purchases, progression items, passes, and convenience features, then evaluate value without presenting spending as required.

confirmed-aniimo.title: Confirmed Aniimo List: Official Creatures Revealed
confirmed-aniimo.description: A verified overview of officially revealed Aniimo, including Emberpup, Celestis, Nimbi, Bolty and evolution lines.
body: The official index is live
The public official Aniimo Wiki listed 94 visible entries when checked on August 30, 2026. These are confirmed index records rather than names inferred from leaks or fan art.
Early official examples
Emberpup begins the official index at No.001, followed by Flameruff, Scorchhowl, and Inferlupa. Celestis and Stellarys appear at No.005–006, while Nimbi is No.018 and Bolty is No.048.
Elements and roles
The official index uses nine element filters: holy, fire, ice, dark, electric, grass, water, rock, and wind. Its five role filters are DPS, Heal, Support, Break, and Regen.
How to use the table
The table below shares one structured source across all site languages. Each row links to its official Wiki entry and records the stage, elements and role returned by the official index.
Why this is not a tier list
Confirmation does not establish strength. Stats and skills can change before or after launch, so rankings remain separate until repeatable release-version testing is complete.

catching-twine.title: Aniimo Catching & Twine System Explained
catching-twine.description: How catching, Aniipods, traps, creature forms and the Twine transformation system work in Aniimo.
body: How catching works
Official descriptions say Pathfinders catch Aniimo with Aniipods, can set traps, and need to time the catch. Exact capture-rate formulas and item modifiers should be verified in the release build.
Spawns respond to the world
Aniimo can appear according to environment, weather, phenomena, and time of day. A useful location guide therefore needs more than a single coordinate: it should record conditions and version.
What Twine means
Twine lets a Pathfinder become a collected Aniimo and use that creature's skills and perspective. It supports combat, puzzle solving, traversal, and environmental challenges.
Traversal examples

Official material specifically shows gliding, diving, and burrowing. Individual official Wiki entries also list mobility or pathfinding abilities, such as Emberpup's faster movement and Nimbi's aerial dash.
What we will verify at launch
We will test catch timing, trap behavior, failed-catch costs, form availability, stamina, cooldowns, and whether multiplayer changes capture ownership.

multiplayer.title: Aniimo Multiplayer: Co-op, PvP, Player Count & Egg Heist
multiplayer.description: Does Aniimo have multiplayer? See confirmed online co-op, PvP, solo play, three-player Egg Heist and the features still unconfirmed for launch.
body: What multiplayer means in Aniimo

Steam confirms single-player, online co-op, online PvP and cross-platform multiplayer. Multiplayer describes the available online activities; crossplay specifically describes playing across platforms. The store also discloses in-game chat and online interaction.
Three-player Egg Heist

The official update describes Egg Heist as a PvEvP activity in the Lost Isles. Players join a three-person team, gather supplies, enter a forbidden area, fight other Pathfinders and compete for the Giant Darkler Egg.
Co-op and story limits are not confirmed

Official descriptions mention solo and multiplayer exploration, but do not yet specify party size outside Egg Heist, drop-in story co-op, guest quest credit, shared catching ownership or world-host progression.
Open-world social spaces

Each Pathfinder has a personal RV at a campsite where players can meet and interact. Homeland activities include planting crops, building decorations and arranging a personal space with Aniimo; the official descriptions do not yet define these spaces as full campaign co-op.
Crossplay belongs in the platform guide

Cross-platform multiplayer is confirmed as a feature, while cross-save, account linking, regional servers, friend limits, voice chat and console subscription requirements remain pending. See the dedicated Crossplay and Cross-Save guide for the current platform matrix.

Is Aniimo co-op?
Online co-op is officially listed, but the full campaign co-op scope and general open-world party limit have not been published.
How many players are in Egg Heist?
The official Egg Heist description specifies a three-player team.
Can I play Aniimo solo?
Yes. Single-player is officially listed, and official descriptions refer to both solo and multiplayer play.

regions-world.title: Aniimo Regions & World Guide: The Continent of Idyll
regions-world.description: Explore the six officially revealed Aniimo regions across Idyll, including forests, coasts, flower fields and cloud grasslands.
body: The continent of Idyll
Aniimo takes place across Idyll, an open world designed around catching, Twine abilities, traversal, challenges, races, discovery, and social camps.
Forest of Falling Stars and Mistwoods
Forest of Falling Stars is a dense purple forest where Celestises glide among starine trees. Mistwoods is a poisonous swamp forest where glowing fruit helps guide travelers.
Echoback Landing and Sea of Flowers
Echoback Landing centers on an enormous stranded Aniimo and the mystery of its song. Sea of Flowers surrounds a perfume-making village with vast purple flower fields.
Blitzwood and Nimbus Fields
Blitzwood is scarred by lightning drawn to Bolties and filled with thunder-struck trees. Nimbus Fields places low clouds over broad grasslands where Nimbis bounce across the terrain.
How the map will expand
The current guide covers only officially named regions. Coordinates, resource nodes, quests, fast-travel points, weather cycles, and spawn tables will be added after in-game verification.

accessibility-features.title: Aniimo PS5 Accessibility Features: Subtitles, Controls & Audio
accessibility-features.description: Aniimo's 15 listed PS5 accessibility features covering subtitles, audio, controls, reminders, practice mode, saving and voice-chat transcription.
body: Scope of this guide
PlayStation currently lists 15 accessibility features for the PS5 version. These store tags describe PS5 support only; equivalent PC, Xbox, iOS and Android settings have not yet been confirmed.
Audio and subtitles

The listing includes separate volume controls, 3D Audio, basic subtitles and clear subtitles. PlayStation describes the basic subtitle feature as covering the main story and main characters, so this should not be read as confirmation that every ambient or multiplayer line is captioned.
Controller options

Listed control features include basic controller remapping, basic stick-sensitivity adjustment, play without button holds, play without motion controls, play without controller vibration and play without adaptive-trigger resistance.
Learning and saving

Control reminders, tutorial reminders, practice mode and manual saving are listed. PlayStation describes practice mode as a consequence-free environment available throughout the game and manual saving as creating return points, but final in-game limitations still need release testing.
Online communication

Voice-chat transcription is listed, allowing voice chats to be displayed as text. The store page does not describe supported languages, speaker labels, profanity filtering or whether transcription covers every voice channel.
What we will verify at launch

We will check menu location, subtitle size and contrast, remapping range, hold-versus-toggle behavior, sensitivity sliders, vibration defaults, manual-save restrictions, practice access and transcription accuracy on the public PS5 build.

Can Aniimo controls be remapped on PS5?

Can vibration and adaptive triggers be disabled?
PlayStation lists play without controller vibration and play without adaptive-trigger effects.

Yes, it is listed for PS5, but supported languages and channel coverage are not yet described.
Are these features confirmed on PC, Xbox and mobile?
No. This list comes from the PS5 store page; other platforms need their own official listing or release testing.

preorder-bundles.title: Aniimo Pre-Order Packs: Advanced vs Collector's Edition
preorder-bundles.description: Compare Aniimo's PS5 Advanced and Collector's pre-order packs, prices, Companion Handbooks, exclusive reward and free base game.
body: The base game is free

Aniimo launches as a free-to-play game. The PlayStation pre-order prices buy optional reward packs, not access to the base game. Players can wait for launch and download the base game without buying either edition.
Advanced Edition — US$9.99 on PS5

The Advanced pack includes the free base-game listing, one PlayStation-exclusive Fluffy Friend accessory and one Advanced Companion Handbook. The handbook includes a version-dependent Prismana Aniimo Egg with Perfect Potential, a related branching-evolution material and other progression rewards unlocked as the handbook levels.
Collector's Edition — US$19.99 on PS5

The Collector's listing includes the free base-game listing, the same Fluffy Friend accessory and a Collector's Companion Handbook. PlayStation does not provide a complete item-by-item comparison on the main product page, so this guide does not invent additional Collector rewards.
Important handbook conditions

The handbook is an in-game item that remains active until the end of the current version after redemption. Its exclusive Prismana Egg can vary by version, so the actual reward depends on when it is redeemed.
Deadline and regional pricing

The PlayStation pre-order period ends September 16, 2026 at 09:59 UTC+8, one minute before the listed PS5 launch. US prices are US$9.99 and US$19.99; local prices, taxes and refund rules can differ by PlayStation region.
Should you pre-order?

Buy only if the listed cosmetic and handbook rewards are worth the local price to you. A purchase is not required to play, and the current listing does not establish the long-term value of handbook progression or version-dependent eggs.
